text:
jessica_support: Escalation from AcmeCorp — their integration crashes when using JSON mode streaming. They see 'unexpected end of JSON input' in Go and JSONDecodeError in Python. Customer says it happens when the model emits multiline strings (\n inside JSON string). Repro steps & raw frames below.

tony_sdk: Can you paste the raw SSE frames/packets? Also the SDK versions and whether they're using Python/TS/Go? Suspect boundary split in stream assembler.

jessica_support: They're on python-sdk v0.8.3 and go-sdk v0.5.1. Raw frames (copied from client tcpdump):
```
data: {"id":"r_abc","object":"response","output_mode":"json","delta":"{\\\"text\\\": \\\"line1\\nline2\\nline3\\\""}

data: {"id":"r_abc","object":"response","delta":"\\\", \"meta\": {}}
```

michael_engineer: Looks like the SSE 'data:' frames split in the middle of a quoted string containing embedded \n. Our stream-parsers assume each 'data:' event contains a complete JSON blob; when split we try to unmarshal partial bytes and get EOF. Go Unmarshal error: "invalid character '\n' looking for beginning of value". Python's streaming NDJSON reader gets an incomplete record -> JSONDecodeError.

sara_customer_success: Customer impact: their background job processes streamed JSON and crashes intermittently when the model emits code blocks or long strings. It's blocking their staging rollouts. Marking P1 for support side. :exclamation:

qa-bot: Quick repro script ran against staging model and reproduced 3/10 streams. Failure pattern: a JSON string with escaped newline (\\n) gets split across two SSE events. Collector incorrectly treats each event as independent JSON. Error snippets:
```
Python: json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
Go: json: unexpected end of JSON input
```

tony_sdk: Proposed fix: change the assembler to concatenate consecutive 'data:' payloads until a complete JSON object is detected (brace/bracket balance or final `event: done`). Longer-term: consider switching default framing to length-prefixed frames or ndjson (each line a full JSON object). Short-term mitigation: advise customers to use non-streaming responses or set response_format="ndjson". I'll open a PR with a small patch to the stream reader to buffer until a valid parse succeeds.

jessica_support: Thanks — assigning INC-2026-124 and notifying the customer about the mitigation. Please tag me on the PR and ping when a staging build is available.

tony_sdk: Will do. Draft PR target branch: fix/stream-assembler-multiline. Adding tests that simulate split frames with embedded escapes.

jessica_support: Great, appreciated.
